alignment.instructions: Assess whether the supplied page excerpt/title credibly serves the search query and any provided ad promise; do not claim the full page is verified.

criteria.strong: Page excerpt clearly addresses the same user need and offer as the query/promise
criteria.partial: Some overlap, but key aspects of user intent or promise are absent from the excerpt
criteria.mismatch: Page excerpt clearly addresses a different intent or offer
criteria.insufficient: Title and excerpt do not provide enough context to judge

intent_covered.instructions: Is there explicit support in the supplied title and excerpt that this page answers the user's specific search intent?

specificity.instructions: How specific is the supplied excerpt to the promised/search intent?
criteria: Precise response with meaningful details that meet the expressed intent
